name: popcraft-cli-build-a-design
description: A launch post, story and landscape ad from one design script, built and checked with the popcraft command line.

scripts.build: popcraft new launch.popcraft --name Launch && popcraft run launch.popcraft write_design --size ig-post --name Launch --script @launch.js
scripts.export: popcraft run launch.popcraft export.nodes --format PNG --scale 1 --out out/
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run outline
